policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides (min_market_gap_pp, min_win_confidence_pp, min_ev_pct, ml_lo/ml_hi, allowed_sides, min_spread_cover_gap_pp, min_spread_confidence_pp, min_spread_point_edge) are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests.

mlb.note: MLB v2 (75 features: ISO/XBH, bullpen outs-5, SP FIP trend, platoon K/OBP matchups, market-aware ML head + open→close steam) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +34.3% (2024-2026, CLV +21.8%); closing-line floor -2.2% — prior gate study; re-run backtest after feature expansion before treating as live ROI. Bets recorded in the morning sit between those brackets.

nba.note: NBA v2 (90 features: team four-factors + schedule/context + player minutes/usage/AST-TOV/DNP/bench + starter-rest; market heads add spread/ML + open→close steam) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nba_bets.py): market-aware margin model cover gap >= 10 pp at the opening spread. Opening-line ROI +24.6% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (2024-2026, 627 bets, worst-season +15.3%) — prior gate study on 89-feature stack; re-run after expansion before treating as live ROI. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

wnba.note: WNBA v2 (79 features incl. NBA-parity rotation/DNP/usage; OOS LL ~0.623) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_wnba_bets.py): pure margin model cover probability vs the juice-implied break-even. Live Hubáček gate in this file stays at 8 pp cover gap with a 5 pp confidence floor (prior open-line backtest at that gate: +5.2% ROI / 321 bets on the thinner 66-feature stack). data/models/wnba_v2/bet_policy.json may use a different grid for research — that is not the live site gate. Morning bets sit between open and close.

cbb.note: Official tracking stays disabled. CBBGradientBoost v2 now has 70 pure features (four-factor/pace when ESPN boxes available; market heads soft-skip until odds coverage grows). Prior close-line Hubacek sweep still catastrophic (−57.9% best / −71.7% at live gates on 2024–25 window) — feature expansion alone does not clear the enable bar. Re-enable only after multi-season positive worst-season close (or open with non-terrible close floor). Expand odds: python scripts/fetch_cbb_odds.py --start-season 2022 --end-season 2026.

nfl.note: NFLGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (65 features: team Elo/EWMA + QB/coach Elo + coach streaks + rest/weather/roof/div; live now injects nflverse QB/coach/weather for train/serve parity; market-aware heads when MLs present). OOS margin MAE ~10.45. Official picks stay disabled: close-only Hubacek sweep still has negative worst-season ROI (best about -12.6% on prior stack). nflverse has no opening lines. Gate parameters kept for reference only.

cfb.note: CFBGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (60 features: short-week/bye, power-conf, QB EntityElo stub, luck proxies; OOS LL ~0.526 / margin MAE ~13.50). Official picks stay disabled: best spread policy worst-season ROI remains negative (~-5% on prior stack). Gate parameters kept for reference only.

nhl.note: NHL v2 (93 features: flurry/rebound xG, PP/PK ice, goalie HD GSAx, giveaways/hits-against/corsi-all/EV-xG-share/PP-TOI share, schedule density; market-aware ML head) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nhl_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 7 pp (7.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -350..+300. Opening-line ROI +9.4% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (CLV +3.95%); closing-line 12-season ROI +6.1% — prior gate study; re-run after feature expansion before treating as live ROI. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

epl.note: Soccer v2 pooled top-5 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_soccer_bets.py): market-aware calibrated home prob beats the devigged opening line by >= 4 pp raw (4.6 pp after 1.15x decorrelation), EV >= 5% — home outcomes only (draw/away legs were not profitable). Engine now 57 pure features (+yellow/red burden, corners against). Best-price execution ROI +4.3% across 2015-2025 with 10/11 seasons positive, CLV +4.0% (65% positive-CLV bets) — prior gate study; re-run after expansion before treating as live ROI.
